items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: When we were at 63rd Street, you knew all those people like Benny Carter and Russell Procope. ... Oh yeah! ... They were all there!

ctx.x: See, I remember it because the band here was in the sewer... Now, we used to play checkers, and use them on the sewer. That's the very sewer where the fight occurred; that's how I remember. Also, Benny used to put me up on a gate, and I couldn't get down. He used to laugh at me... Then Gene Michael, I remember Gene... They were all Byo Scouts, and they used to play, he and Russell Procope...
